title: Add to the Line
prompt: Build the command that adds one more crate to the end of the satchel.

fragments.wrong_hint: pop() REMOVES the last crate. To ADD one to the end, use .append(crate).
Square brackets look up or replace a slot — they don't grow the list. append does.

config.success: satchel.append(crate) — one more crate on the end of the line.
